source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Seattle must use a standalone Wix account and remain entirely separate from Bay Area Smash Room.

Seattle must have separate:

Bookings
Customer database
Analytics
Memberships
Gift cards
Payment processing
Staff access
Payouts

Customers should experience it as the same SMASH ROOM brand, while all backend operations remain completely independent.

Initially, Seattle should be presented as a “Coming Soon” location.

The Seattle page must follow this layout:

Hero Banner
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
FAQ
Photo Gallery
Contact Information
VIP Email Signup

The buttons should be:

Join VIP List
Opening Soon

Design the page so that when Seattle opens, booking only needs to be enabled and the photos updated, with no page redesign required.

Use the Seattle page as the template for future locations.

value_updates.opening_transition: Enable booking and update photos without redesigning the page

routing_warnings.description: The mockup uses the wrong company identity; this is a branding failure rather than a failure of the coming-soon page behavior.
The client specifies imagery for Splatter Room and Axe Throwing, which belongs to the activity-imagery Requirement.
The freelancer specifically claims installation of the booking system on the second website.
The complaint that the two websites are identical concerns the missing distinction between the national master site and the location site, not a specific coming-soon page acceptance behavior.
The client requires a location-selection menu that directs visitors to the appropriate location website.
The reported failure concerns the Seattle and master websites being assigned to the wrong Wix profiles.
